##### Project general facts

MJL Elara by Meraas is a premium residential development designed around family living, with a strong focus on spaciousness, comfort, and privacy. The development offers a higher proportion of 2- and 3-bedroom residences, complemented by contemporary architecture and thoughtfully planned layouts that maximise views in all directions. Controlled access and direct entry to each building from the shared basement and main lobby provide residents with added convenience and security.

The development offers a wellness-focused lifestyle with a range of premium amenities. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool, a gym with 360-degree views, sky gardens, and a rooftop terrace, creating spaces for fitness, relaxation, and outdoor enjoyment. Carefully designed landscaping further enhances the community, creating a welcoming environment that complements the contemporary architecture and provides residents with a sense of privacy and tranquillity.

The residences feature premium modern internal finishes, complemented by elegant contemporary interiors throughout the entrance lobbies, lift cabins, and floor lobbies. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise natural light and surrounding views, while high-quality materials create a refined and comfortable living environment. The kitchens are equipped, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Madinat Jumeirah Living is a prestigious residential development nestled within the iconic Madinat Jumeirah resort complex in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Developed by Dubai Holding, this luxurious community offers a unique blend of modern urban living and traditional Arabian charm, making it one of the most sought-after residential destinations in the city.

One of the defining features of Madinat Jumeirah Living is its exceptional location. Situated between the glistening waters of the Arabian Gulf and the picturesque backdrop of the Burj Al Arab, residents of this community enjoy breathtaking views and a serene ambiance. It's a place where you can wake up to the soothing sound of the sea and indulge in the splendor of Dubai's skyline. For those seeking wellness and recreation, the development boasts lush landscaped gardens, swimming pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and children's play areas. It's a place where you can unwind, stay active, and create lasting memories with family and friends.

Madinat Jumeirah Living's strategic location also provides convenient access to Dubai's major attractions, business districts, and transportation links, ensuring that residents are well-connected to the rest of the city. Located 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, Madinat Jumeirah Living is just a few minutes from Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina. It is adjacent to Burj Al Arab, Wild Wadi Waterpark™, Jumeirah Beach Hotel, major shopping malls, public transport links and schools.
